$comment: Repository settings configuration for cuioss organization. Used by setup-repo-settings.py

homepage.$comment: Sidebar 'Include in home page' toggles. No API exists to apply these — advisory only.

labels.$comment: Applied by reusable-dependabot-auto-merge.yml and consumed by dependabot-sweeper.yml. That workflow holds only pull-requests: write and cannot create labels, so it must exist before the first eligible PR.
labels.name: automerge
labels.description: Eligible for automated merge by the cuioss dependabot sweeper

labels.$comment: Opt-out honoured by CodeRabbit, PR-Agent/Gemini and Sourcery. Applied by consumer_update_utils.create_pr_and_auto_merge so release propagation does not spend a bot review on a mechanical version bump in every consumer repo. Declaring it here also normalises the colour and description, which drifted across the repos where it was created by hand.
labels.name: skip-bot-review

$repositories_comment: Empty means every active non-fork repository in the organization, resolved from the API at run time. Name repositories explicitly only to narrow a run; a hand-maintained list drifts silently as repositories are added.
